parameters.content:
## Reason capture
The Reject button on the approval card opens this form. Its POST action is the paused request's own resume URL, so submitting resumes the main flow with `decision=reject` and the typed reason. No parked wait here.

## Revision loop (thin bridge)
The main flow fires this webhook after it writes its own REJECTED row. Under the cap: notify the requester with the reason + a pre-filled link back into intake (carries `revision_of` + `revision_count`). The revised request is a NEW main-flow run, re-priced and re-routed from scratch. At the cap (3 revisions): close as REJECTED_FINAL and tell requester + cost owner.

## [RUNBOOK - reject to re-approval](https://your-runbook.example/#zone-revision-loop)
*The reject, revise, re-approve loop, documented.*

The node reference for this workflow, the cap and lineage model, and why it is a thin bridge rather than a parked wait, live in the runbook.

The [pr_events](https://your-runbook.example/#pr_events-the-audit-log) columns `revision_of` and `revision_count` are what make rework rate and end-to-end case cycle time a query.
